name: Great Head
notes: Seaside headland above Sand Beach with its own summit marker; Great Head Trail loop.

name: Eagles Crag
notes: Ledge on Cadillac's south ridge; the 0.5-mile Eagles Crag Loop branches off the Cadillac South Ridge Trail.

name: Bald Mountain
notes: Southwest ridge of Bernard, reached by the West Ledge Trail. Inside the park (confirmed on the park map; the legacy boundary layer reads it just outside).

name: Paradise Hill
notes: Inside the park near Hulls Cove; the Paradise Hill carriage road loop circles it with Frenchman Bay views. Bike- and walk-able, no cars.

name: The Whitecap
notes: Knob north of Cadillac; reached by an unmarked path from the summit road, not a maintained trail.

name: Eliot Mountain
notes: Land & Garden Preserve, Northeast Harbor. Eliot Mountain Trail (1 mi), Charles Savage Trail and Asticou Ridge Trail reach the summit. No bikes; dog rules vary by trail.

name: Redfield Hill
notes: Land & Garden Preserve above Little Long Pond, Seal Harbor; the Redfield Hill Trail reaches the summit (confirmed). Height estimated (~300 ft) from neighbouring Barr and Mitchell Hills.

name: Barr Hill
notes: Preserve land south of Redfield Hill; crossed on the Acadia peaks traverse via the Richard Trail. No confirmed summit trail.

name: McFarland Mountain
notes: Behind park headquarters; reached by walking up an old ski slope from the weather station. NPS/URI survey mark at the top.

name: Brewer Mountain
notes: North of Eagle Lake; off-trail from Eagle Lake Road.

name: Great Hill (north)
notes: Between Brewer and Kebo; described as an easy bushwhack.

name: Great Hill (south)
notes: Second GNIS 'Great Hill', near the Park Loop Road by Kebo; reached from the road.

name: Cranberry Hill
notes: Low hill near Schooner Head Road east of Champlain. No known trail.

name: Enoch Mountain
notes: Between Champlain and the Beehive; the old trail is abandoned.

name: Halfway Mountain
notes: Next to Enoch; reached by an abandoned trail.

name: Mitchell Hill
notes: North of Northeast Harbor near Eliot Mountain; inside the park boundary, no known trail.

name: Pine Hill
notes: West of Long Pond, north of Western Mountain; no known trail.

name: Bald Hill
notes: Below Bald Mountain on the south side of Western Mountain; no known trail.

name: China Hill
notes: Near Bass Harbor; reads inside the park boundary. Verify on the park map before listing.

name: Mount Gilboa
notes: Next to China Hill near Bass Harbor; reads inside the park boundary. Verify on the park map.

name: Youngs Mountain
notes: North of McFarland, outside the park on private land (confirmed on the park map).

name: Ox Hill
notes: Seal Harbor, outside the park.

name: Ireson Hill
notes: Salisbury Cove, next to MDI Biological Laboratory; outside the park.

name: Frenchmans Hill
notes: North of Town Hill; outside the park.

name: Schooner Head
notes: Headland summit is outside the park; the park's Schooner Head Overlook is next to it by road.

name: Carter Nubble
notes: East shore of Long Pond, north of Beech Mountain; reads outside the park.

name: Hio Hill
notes: Southwest Harbor/Manset residential area.

name: Robbins Hill
notes: Seal Cove, Tremont.

name: Murphy Hill
notes: Seal Cove, Tremont.

name: Butlers Hill
notes: Seal Cove, Tremont.

name: Billings Hill
notes: Seal Cove shore, Tremont.

name: Burnt Hill
notes: Bass Harbor area, Tremont.

name: Big Rocks
notes: 36-ft knob by Bass Harbor Marsh.
